verdict.rationale: Pulley explicitly markets ASC 718 reporting as part of its compliance product suite for finance teams, alongside audit-defensible 409A valuations, suggesting auditor-ready expense reporting is a supported use case. However, there is no evidence of report format, specifics on what accountants/auditors actually receive, or independent corroboration that outputs are audit-accepted. Missing for 10: sample/detail of the actual ASC 718 report output, evidence of accountant/auditor acceptance in practice, independent third-party validation.
